📱 Apps & Software

Structured

Visual day planner built for ADHD

Editor's Pick

A timeline-based daily planner that makes your day visual and concrete. No more abstract to-do lists — you literally see your time.

Free / $4.99/mo Learn more →

Focusmate

Virtual body doubling on demand

Most Loved

Book 25- or 50-minute sessions with a real accountability partner over video. Body doubling is one of the most effective ADHD productivity tools.

Free / $6.99/mo Learn more →

Notion

All-in-one ADHD command center

Best Value

Build your own second brain. Use templates to manage projects, notes, goals, and habits in one place — fully customisable to how your brain works.

Free / $10/mo Learn more →

Finch

Self-care app with a tiny bird friend

Gamified self-care that makes checking in with yourself feel rewarding. Brilliant for ADHD adults who need external motivation for basic self-care.

Free / $4.99/mo Learn more →

📦 Physical Tools

Rocketbook Everlast

Reusable smart notebook

Top Rated

Write notes by hand (often better for ADHD recall), scan them to the cloud, then wipe clean with a damp cloth. Never lose a note again.

~£30 Learn more →

Fidget Cube

Sensory regulation for focus

Keep your hands busy during calls, meetings, or reading. Proven to improve focus in ADHD adults who need sensory stimulation to stay on task.

~£12 Learn more →

Time Timer

Visual time made concrete

Editor's Pick

A visual timer that shows time disappearing as a shrinking red disk. Essential for time-blindness — actually SEEING time pass changes everything.

~£28 Learn more →

📚 Books We Recommend

Driven to Distraction

Hallowell & Ratey — The ADHD bible

Essential Read

The foundational ADHD book by two psychiatrists with ADHD. Compassionate, clinical, and life-changing. Read this first.

~£12 Learn more →

Smart but Stuck

Thomas E. Brown — Executive function in depth

Explains the executive function impairments behind ADHD with vivid case studies. Helps you finally understand WHY you struggle with "simple" tasks.

~£14 Learn more →

The ADHD Advantage

Dale Archer — Reframe the narrative

Explores how ADHD traits become genuine strengths in the right environment. Great for rebuilding self-esteem after years of "not trying hard enough."

~£11 Learn more →
